{{Quote|Whoever you are, you're about to learn that the ''Jedi starfighter'' is full of surprises!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]|<ref name="FoS" />}}
This '''starfighter''' was a prototype used by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the final [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|At the controls of this ship, speed and safety are of little concern.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="FoS" />}}
[[File:Jedi_Starfighter_fightmodus.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Obi-Wan Kenobi showing off the offensive capabilities of his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] while in fight mode.]]The fighter included a fight mode feature which enabled its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to eject the outer [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the fighter's nose, exposing a vast array of weapons.<ref name="FoS" />

These modifications included 10 [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], two [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] and [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]]. With these upgrades, the pilot could turn the tide of the [[Space warfare/Legends|space battle]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] regarded this [[Starship/Legends|ship]] as being "full of surprises."<ref name="FoS" />

==History==
{{Quote|Tell Anakin we'll continue his training once I return&mdash;if he's not too envious of me flying this Jedi starfighter, that is.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="FoS" />}}
Obi-Wan Kenobi most notably used this starfighter while on a [[Mission to Albecus|mission]] to deliver a message of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Albecus]]. During his journey, Kenobi was pursued by the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], piloted by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Fett's deadly maneuvers forced Kenobi to convert his ship into fight mode. With the overwhelming firepower of his starfighter, Kenobi forced Fett to retreat, and was able to safely carry out the rest of his mission.<ref name="FoS" />
